name: GitHub
description: Search GitHub repositories, create and merge pull requests, manage issues and Actions workflows, and track your GitHub notifications.
author: thomaslombart

preferences.name: personalAccessToken
preferences.title: GitHub Token
preferences.description: Your GitHub's personal access token. Required scopes: notifications repo project read:org read:user. Add read:packages to use the My Packages commands.

preferences.name: defaultSearchTerms
preferences.title: Default Search Terms
preferences.description: Default search to be populated when searching issues, pull requests and discussions.

preferences.name: numberOfResults
preferences.title: Search Results per Page
preferences.description: For repository, issue, discussion, or pull request searches, this is the number of results requested per page. Fewer results per page will load faster.

preferences.name: baseClonePath
preferences.title: Default Clone Path
preferences.description: Used by the 'Clone and Open' action. 'Clone with Options' starts here but lets you choose a different directory.

preferences.name: vscodeBuild
preferences.title: VS Code Build
preferences.description: Which editor to use for the Clone in VS Code action. Applies to Search Repositories, My Latest Repositories, and My Starred Repositories.

preferences.name: repositoryCloneProtocol
preferences.title: Repository Clone Protocol
preferences.label: Protocol for Cloning Repositories
preferences.description: The protocol to use when cloning a repository.

preferences.title: Actions
preferences.label: Open PRs in browser by default
preferences.name: isOpenInBrowser
preferences.description: If checked, pull requests will be opened in the browser by default instead of viewing them within Raycast.

preferences.name: includeTeamReviewRequests

preferences.label: PRs include team review requests
preferences.description: Include PRs where your team's review was requested as well as your own.
